references.name: reference/north-approach
references.shows: The whole castle from the north approach: the tall gatehouse, the lower hall range, the kitchen tower, the three ditches and the timber bridge. The style anchor for the series.

references.name: concept/approach-near
references.shows: On the timber bridge at the last ditch, looking up at the gatehouse front and through the raised portcullis into the gate passage.

references.name: concept/gate-passage-near
references.shows: Inside the vaulted gate passage: murder holes overhead, the yett folded back, the guardroom door, the pit prison in the floor, the courtyard bright at the far end.

references.name: concept/gate-passage-far
references.shows: The gatehouse cut open from the north-east, showing the gate passage running through its ground floor with the lord's hall and duchess's hall stacked above it.

references.name: concept/courtyard-near
references.shows: The courtyard at the well, looking north at the three external stairs that climb to the lord's hall, the great hall and the kitchen tower.

references.name: concept/courtyard-far
references.shows: The courtyard from above the south-east corner, over the wall-walk: the well, the three stairs and the whole north range.

references.name: concept/lords-hall-near
references.shows: The lord's hall on the gatehouse first floor: the double fireplace, the long table, the carved screen and gallery, banners and plate.

references.name: concept/lords-hall-far
references.shows: The gatehouse cut open from the courtyard side, showing the lord's hall sitting directly on the gate passage, with the external stair up to its door.

references.name: concept/duchess-hall-near
references.shows: The duchess's hall on the second floor with its oratory alcove: altar, piscina and credence niche, and the bedchamber through the door.

references.name: concept/duchess-hall-far
references.shows: The top of the gatehouse cut open: the duchess's hall, the round tower bedchamber, and the parapet and garret above.

references.name: concept/great-hall-near
references.shows: The great hall from the screens end: the open central hearth under its louvre, trestle tables, and the high table on the dais at the far end.

references.name: concept/great-hall-far
references.shows: The hall range cut open from the courtyard: the hall end to end with its dais and hearth, and the three barrel-vaulted cellars beneath it.

references.name: concept/kitchen-near
references.shows: The vaulted kitchen: the great fireplace with its cauldron crane, the bread oven, the work table, hanging game and the floor drain.

references.name: concept/kitchen-far
references.shows: The kitchen tower cut open from the south-west: the kitchen and servery at hall level, the cellar below, the royal apartments above.

references.name: concept/royal-apartments-near
references.shows: The audience chamber of the royal apartments: the canopied chair of state, the fireplace, and the bedchamber through the door.

references.name: concept/royal-apartments-far
references.shows: The kitchen tower from the north-west with its upper floors cut open, the west postern and curtain beyond.

references.name: concept/wall-walk-near
references.shows: On the south wall-walk looking along the parapet, the courtyard and well below on one side and the river valley through the crenels on the other.

references.name: concept/wall-walk-far
references.shows: The whole castle from the south: the wall-walk circuit, the courtyard inside it, and the north range beyond, in its valley.
